Indmar Marine Engines
Millington, TN
Description
At Indmar Marine Engines, we are dedicated to designing, manufacturing and selling high quality inboard marine engines that deliver a mix of unrivaled performance, meticulous craftsmanship and groundbreaking innovations. We believe our employees and the different perspectives that they bring to the business are the driving force behind our success.
Indmar is seeking an experienced leader to manager our Production Department. The Production Manager leads the engine assembly team in the building of gasoline-powered marine engines. This position plans and assigns work, implements policies and procedures and recommends and implements improvements in production methods, equipment, operating procedures and working conditions.
Requirements
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Ensures effective employee relations. Provides employee coaching and development; resolves employee issues through problem resolution; leads a team that is both effective and efficient.
Balances quality, productivity, budget, safety and morale to achieve positive results in all areas.
Works to continuously improve in all areas of production.
Manages departmental performance measures, including visual controls and provides regular progress reports to the plant manager.
Maintains proper inventory levels of shop materials and PPE for production employees.
Manages department priorities and strategic goals and initiatives.
Ensures all ISO 9001 standards are followed, to include maintaining required documentation and training matrix.
Works with Engineering on all new product launches to ensure an effective transition from design to manufacturing.
Fosters a positive company culture and leads by example.
Other duties as assigned.
Knowledge And Skills
Strong ability to lead people, communicate effectively and produce results through others.
Ability to plan, prioritize and prepare action plans to achieve results.
Willingness and ability to train and develop team.
Manage employee performance feedback and discipline regularly and effectively, holding team accountable to goals and policy standards.
Ability to balance and achieve positive results in the areas of safety, quality, productivity, cost and employee relations.
Systems and continuous improvement orientation.
Ability to analyze problems and work with appropriate team members to determine resolution.
Inventory management.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Strong team player.
Advanced knowledge of engines and their parts and components as well as hand tools and air tools.
Education And Work Experience
High School graduate or GED; Additional training or secondary education is preferred.
5 years previous supervisory experience desired.
Previous manufacturing experience with a preference in the automotive or marine industry.
ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS: Manufacturing and office environment.
PHYSICAL EFFORT: Must be able to lift 50 pounds.

Director of Quality
Innodyne Systems
Bloomfield, CT
The Director of Quality is responsible for leading and managing all quality assurance, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement activities for the FAA Part 145 Repair Station. This position ensures the organization maintains full compliance with FAA regulations, customer requirements, OEM standards, and internal quality management systems while promoting a culture of safety, accountability, and operational excellence.
The Director of Quality serves as the primary authority for inspection systems, quality procedures, audits, corrective actions, and regulatory interactions. This role partners closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, and executive leadership to drive compliance, reduce risk, and improve overall operational performance.
Essential Job Functions
Ensure continuous compliance with FAA Part 145 regulations and Repair Station Manual (RSM) requirements.
Maintain oversight of the Quality Management System (QMS) including policies, procedures, and inspection processes.
Ensure full compliance with all applicable FAA, EASA,CAAC, CAA (UK), ISO9001/9110,OSHA, and customer-specific safety and quality regulations, standards, and procedures.
Serve as the primary liaison with the FAA, customers, and regulatory agencies during audits, inspections, and investigations.
Lead and manage Quality Assurance, Receiving Inspection, Final Inspection, and Internal Audit functions.
Establish andmaintaininspection standards to ensure product conformity and airworthiness.
Review and approve corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) related to quality findings, escapes, and audit observations.
Develop and manage internal audit schedules and external audit readiness programs.
Lead customer, FAA, and third-party quality audits and ensuretimelyresolution of findings.
Analyze quality metrics and operational trends to identify opportunities for improvement.
Lead, mentor, and develop Quality department personnel including inspectors, auditors, and quality engineers.
Collaborate cross-functionallywith Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and leadership teams to support companyobjectives.
Lead oversight of quality management systems to ensure procedures are consistently followed and documentedin accordance withPart 145 Repair Station requirements.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Requirements
Minimum 8–10 years of progressive aviation quality experience within an FAA Part 145 Repair Station environment(MRO Experience).
Strong working knowledge of:
FAA Part 145 regulations
FAA Airworthiness requirements
Repair Station Manual requirements
Quality Management Systems
AS9100/ISO standards
CAAC requirements
EASA requirements
CAA (UK) requirements
SMS requirements
Bachelor’s degree inaviation,engineering,qualitymanagement,business, or related field preferred.
Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing quality teams in an aviation MRO environment.
Experience leading FAA and customer audits.
Strong understanding of maintenance documentation, technical publications, and regulatory compliance practices.

In addition, this candidate will sit on DAA Quality leadership team and work/collaborate with Corporate Quality functions responsible for NPI Quality Assurance, QA programs, Supplier Quality and QMS.

Vice President of Operations and Supply Chain
Better Earth
Atlanta, GA
Vice President of Operations and Supply Chain
Location: Atlanta, GA or Chicago, IL preferred; exceptional candidates outside these areas will be considered
Employment Type: Full-Time, Exempt
Department: Operations
Reports To: Chief Executive Officer
Travel: Regular domestic and international travel required
About the Role
Better Earth is a mission-driven sustainable packaging company creating environmentally responsible alternatives that help reduce waste and support a circular economy.
We are seeking a highly independent, hands-on Vice President of Operations and Supply Chain to assume full day-to-day responsibility for Customer Service, Operations, Supply Chain, Warehousing, Fulfillment, and Logistics.
This is a critical leadership role designed for an experienced operator who can independently run the day-to-day operating functions of the business, establish priorities, make decisions, resolve cross-functional issues, develop the team, and ensure customer commitments are fulfilled.
This is a player-coach role in a lean, entrepreneurial organization—not a strategy-only position. The successful candidate must be equally comfortable leading managers and personally working through operating data, processes, supplier issues, customer-service challenges, and execution gaps when necessary.
What You’ll Own
Provide day-to-day leadership across Customer Service, Operations, Supply Chain, Warehousing, Fulfillment, and Logistics.
Establish operating priorities, clear ownership, KPIs, processes, and accountability across the organization.
Lead supply planning, demand planning, purchasing, inventory management, product availability, and supplier performance.
Oversee warehouse operations, third-party logistics providers, fulfillment partners, inbound/outbound logistics, freight performance, and carrier relationships.
Improve forecasting, inventory visibility, service levels, working capital, order accuracy, fulfillment performance, and cost-to-serve.
Establish effective operating cadences, dashboards, SOPs, escalation procedures, and corrective-action processes.
Identify recurring operational issues, determine root causes, and implement sustainable solutions.
Partner closely with Sales to ensure customer commitments are operationally achievable and customers receive proactive, accurate communication.
Manage operating budgets, forecasts, productivity initiatives, and cost controls in partnership with Finance.
Coach and develop managers while establishing clear expectations and accountability for results.
Work directly with domestic and international suppliers, manufacturers, logistics partners, warehouses, and customers as needed.
Provide the CEO with concise reporting on operational performance, material risks, corrective actions, and decisions requiring executive input.
What We’re Looking For
The right leader is highly self-directed, accountable, practical, and comfortable making decisions with imperfect information. You identify problems early and bring recommendations rather than simply escalating issues.
You can move naturally between executive leadership and hands-on execution. You know how to introduce structure and discipline without slowing down an entrepreneurial organization, and you can hold people accountable while developing stronger, more independent managers.
We are looking for someone interested in building for the long term and prepared to make a meaningful professional commitment to strengthening the people, processes, systems, and infrastructure required for Better Earth’s next stage of growth.
Qualifications
10+ years of progressive experience across operations, supply chain, logistics, fulfillment, distribution, customer service, or related functions.
Experience independently leading multiple operating functions within a growing, founder-led, or entrepreneurial organization.
Demonstrated ability to operate as both a senior leader and hands-on individual contributor.
Strong experience in demand planning, supply planning, inventory management, procurement, warehousing, fulfillment, and transportation.
Experience managing third-party warehouses, contract manufacturers, suppliers, and logistics providers.
Proven success developing KPIs, SOPs, operating cadences, dashboards, and performance-accountability systems.
Strong financial understanding of inventory, working capital, freight, warehousing, COGS, margin, and cost-to-serve.
Experience coaching managers and improving team performance.
Packaging, foodservice, distribution, manufacturing, or adjacent industry experience strongly preferred.
Bachelor’s degree preferred; an equivalent combination of relevant experience and demonstrated results will be considered.
Proficiency with ERP, CRM, analytics, reporting, and Microsoft 365 systems.
Valid passport and ability to travel regularly, both domestically and internationally.
Location & Travel
Atlanta or Chicago area candidates are preferred. Exceptional candidates located outside these areas will also be considered, provided they are able and willing to travel regularly to Better Earth locations and other business partners.
Regular domestic and international travel is required, including visits to warehouses and fulfillment facilities, suppliers, manufacturers, vendors, customers, and other business partners.
Compensation
Better Earth offers a competitive compensation package commensurate with the selected candidate’s experience, qualifications, and final scope of responsibility.
The package is expected to include a competitive base salary, annual performance-based incentive opportunity, eligibility for Better Earth’s applicable long-term incentive or equity program, and comprehensive employee benefits.
Compensation and Pay Equity Commitment
Better Earth is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Candidates are evaluated based on their skills, experience, qualifications, and the position’s requirements.
Compensation decisions are based on relevant market data, internal equity, experience, qualifications, and the role’s final scope. Better Earth does not request or consider a candidate’s current or prior compensation when making compensation decisions.

Principal Customer Quality Program Manager
Beehive Industries, LLC
Centennial, CO
Beehive Industries is dedicated to Powering American Defense by revolutionizing the design, development, and delivery of jet propulsion systems to support the warfighter. Through the integration of additive manufacturing, the company aims to meet the growing and urgent needs for unmanned aerial defense by dramatically improving a jet engine’s speed to market, fuel efficiency, and cost.
Founded in 2020, the company is headquartered in Centennial, Colorado, with additional facilities in Knoxville, Tennessee, Loveland Ohio, and Mount Vernon, Ohio. Beehive is committed to grow and advance the defense industrial base while manufacturing exclusively in the USA. This role will be located at our Centennial, Colorado or Cincinnati, Ohio facility.
Role Overview
The Principal Customer Quality Program Manager acts as the primary quality interface for Beehive Industries' strategic customers. This role is responsible for interpreting, negotiating, and deploying customer quality flowdowns, managing all customer quality matters (including quality escapes regardless of internal origin), and strengthening customer relationships. The incumbent partners cross-functionally with Sustaining Engineering, Product Line Management, Legal, Contracts, and Operations to ensure requirements are understood, met, and continuously improved across the enterprise.
What You’ll Do...
Serve as the direct point of contact for all customer quality inquiries, concerns, and strategic quality communications Beehive-wide
Interpret, negotiate, and deploy customer quality flowdown requirements; coordinate cross-functional actions to ensure compliance
Support or lead negotiation of quality-related contract language and clarifications with customer supply chain and legal teams
Own quality escape management: investigate escape events, lead root cause analysis, manage customer communications, and coordinate corrective and preventive action plans across affected functions
Represent the “Voice of the Customer” within Beehive quality reviews, risk management, product lifecycle, and program gate processes
Lead the preparation, facilitation, and response to customer audits, on-site visits, and ongoing quality reviews
Track, analyze, and report on customer quality metrics, trends, and corrective action effectiveness, providing structured updates to both customers and Beehive leadership
Drive continuous improvement projects based on customer feedback, complaint trends, and internal performance metrics
Proactively identify emerging customer quality issues and escalate as appropriate to ensure timely resolution
Establish a strong quality-focused relationship with Engineering, Product Line, Legal, Contracts, and Operations, advocating for both customer and business interests
Promote a culture of customer-centric quality throughout Beehive Industries
You have...
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Quality, or related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered
Experience
Minimum of 10+ years of progressive experience in quality management within manufacturing or technology industries, including direct experience managing customer accounts or programs
Demonstrated track record interpreting and negotiating customer contract quality flowdowns
Strong cross-functional leadership and ability to influence without authority
Skills & Competencies
Deep understanding of AS9100, ISO9001, and customer quality requirements in regulated industries
Proven ability to engage directly with customers, resolve sensitive issues, and operate as the trusted quality representative
Expertise in root cause analysis, corrective/preventive actions, and structured problem solving
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with experience preparing reports, metrics, and customer presentations
Strong analytical approach with ability to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities
Project management skills including prioritization, planning, and execution across multiple stakeholder groups
Ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment with minimal oversight
Experience with customer, regulatory, or third-party audits
U.S. citizenship required; eligibility to obtain and maintain government security clearance as applicable
Nice to have...
Aerospace, aviation, defense, or automotive manufacturing leadership experience
Experience managing quality organizations supporting production and new product introduction
Experience leading customer, certification, and regulatory audits
Experience with quality software systems, MES, and digital quality tools
Lean Six Sigma certification or other process improvement certification
Experience integrating quality systems following acquisitions or organizational growth
Experience supporting Department of Defense or regulated manufacturing programs
If this sounds like you, please submit an application with your resume. This could be the opportunity you are looking for to expand your skills, contribute to a winning team, and work with talented people who love what they do and take pride in our mission.
